title: SOS WP — WordPress assistance and customer-site collaboration

The work directly supports customers building and improving WordPress websites
The company provides WordPress development, ecommerce, restyling, technical assistance, SEO and maintenance

material_gaps: Freelance/P.IVA and remote-from-Spain terms are not published

Customer-support patience and availability must be evidenced truthfully

next_action.reason: The employer requires its careers form; present VDS as external WordPress support and maintenance capacity and ask whether Spain-based freelance/P.IVA collaboration is accepted.

outcome.evidence: Official careers page verified 2026-10-11; canonical opportunity/API/active-view search and fresh Hostinger/Gmail Sent checks show no SOS WP history.

notes: Fit 90/100 is an assessment, not a win probability.
